description: Apple/Stripe-quality SaaS landing page. Should score 90-100 with near-zero findings.
should_NOT_flag: ANY MUST-level violation (zero tolerance for false positives on a polished site)
REQ-WEB-001 — full semantic HTML (header, nav, main, footer)
acceptable_findings: Things that require user content decisions (og:image, favicon)

enhance_mode_test.description: When running --enhance on this site, it should find very little to improve
enhance_mode_test.expected_response: Site is already well-designed. Minor polish opportunities only.

calibration_purpose: If this site scores below 90 or gets ANY MUST errors, the review tool has a false positive problem. If --enhance suggests major changes, the enhance mode is too aggressive.
